note: Recast from the original English description of Snyder (1926); the original records a single alate female only (holotype, USNM 27644), with the soldier and worker not recorded; locality and collection data and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale chestnut brown, paler along the posterior margin, shining, longer than wide; slightly depressed at the epicranial suture and sloping to the frons, both the epicranial suture and the median line extending clearly to the ocelli; head surface with sparse long hairs. Eyes black, very large, not circular, close to the lateral margins of the head, the distance to the posterior margin about equal to their long diameter. Ocelli large, elongate, angled to but close to the eyes. Labrum pale chestnut brown, length about 3/4 of the width, apex broadly rounded, with long hairs. Antenna pale yellowish brown, 17 segments, moniliform, with short hairs; segment 3 short, subclavate, slightly longer than 2 or 4; segments 4, 5 and 6 subequal in length, small and moniliform; segments gradually longer and wider towards the apex. Pronotum pale yellowish brown, perhaps slightly wider than the head (with the angles drooping), width less than twice the length, anterior and posterior margins slightly concave, sides rounded, with long hairs. Legs pale yellowish brown, with short hairs; claws without arolium. Wings white, punctate, costa yellowish brown; hairs on the upper and lower surfaces, especially near the wing scale; media close to the subcosta, reaching the wing apex without forking (connected to the subcosta only by two faint short cross-veins); subcosta with 7 branches (mostly long) reaching the anterior margin; cubitus about at the middle of the wing, slightly nearer the lower margin, with 11 branches reaching the lower margin. Wing scale 1.0 mm long. Abdomen pale yellowish brown, with long and short hairs. Measurements: alate total length 10.75 mm; dealate total length 7.25 mm; head length 1.65 mm; pronotum length (at the longest point, not at the midline) 0.85 mm; hind tibia length 1.0 mm; fore wing length 8.3 mm; eye long diameter 0.45 mm; head width 1.35 mm; pronotum width more than 1.35 mm (angles drooping); fore wing width 2.45 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Eyes very large (long diameter 0.45 mm), head pale chestnut brown and shining, wings white; body colour paler than in N. fulvescens, body smaller and eyes smaller; possibly the alate caste of N. manni, described by Snyder from soldiers only.
